title: YAAD E SHABBIR
body:
Yaad e Shabbir me Zainab yehi karti thi fugha'n
Bas Tera Gham hai Mere saath Main jaati hu'n jaha'n
<<MINI>>
Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhko Tadapati hai Paiham main Bhulao Kaisay
Meray Akbar kay Kalaijeh main Laagi thi jo Sinaa
<<MINI>>
Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Bolti Kuch nahi kya kaha key Mana'o Isko
Dekhtay Kyun nahi Kubra ka jo Alam hai Ayaa'n
<<MINI>>
Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Maine dekha hai Tere pyaase gale par khanjar
Aaj tak Mere kaleje pa wo khanjar hai rawa'n
<<MINI>>
Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Sogaya Dasht main har naaz Uthanay wala
Kisko dikhlae sakina ya Tamachaou'n key Naasha
<<MINI>>
Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Kufa o Shaam ke baazaaro'n se guzri Bhayya
Dekho baazu pa ubhar aaye hain rassi ke nasha'n
<<MINI>>
Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Chhin gayi Sar se Rida Main gayi darbaaro'n me
Gardane Abide Beemar me thi touge gira'n
<<MINI>>
Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Zulm seh seh ke Sakina ne bhi dam tod diya
Par mayassar na hua Ghuslo kafan ka sama'n
<<MINI>>
Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Behre soughaat liye jaati hu'n Main daaghe rasan
Kya kahu'n poochhe jo Sughra Mera Baba hai kaha'n
<<MINI>>
Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Binte Zehra ke musalsal the yahi bain Rasheed
Mera Abbas kaha'n hai Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
<<MINI>>
Mere Bhayya ho kaha'n
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
